items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: I'd use the fork, and he'd use the cooking spoon and beat on the tub. I'd beat on the basin.

ctx.x: And we used to take railroad spikes and play on the side of the wall. Oh, yeah? And sometimes we'd take the forks out the kitchen. I'd use the fork, and he'd use the cooking spoon and beat on the tub. I'd beat on the basin. And then, from that on, old man Dave got the idea of building up a band back there.
